datasets.tissue: A549 lung cancer cells, RPE-1 cells, neural crest cells from hESC
datasets.description: 97,594 traces of chromosome 22 (27 loci) or chromosome 21 (34 loci): A549-Cas9 cells of a pooled screen of 137 genes (404 sgRNAs and 8 non-targeting controls; each cell's sgRNA as `perturbation`), and CHD7, PCBP1 and ZNF114 knock-downs, CHD7 over-expression and their controls in A549, RPE-1 and neural crest cells. 15 4DN sets.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)

datasets.title: ORCA: the SOX9 region in human ES and neural crest cells
datasets.name: H9 hESC, cranial neural crest · SOX9 locus
datasets.tissue: H9 ES cells and cranial neural crest cells derived from them
datasets.description: 12,764 traces of 78 loci of 5 kb at 50-kb steps across 4 Mb around SOX9 (chr17), in H9 ES cells and in cranial neural crest cells differentiated from them: wild type and lines with the CTCF site at E1.35 or at the SOX9 promoter deleted; spot intensities. Five 4DN sets.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)

datasets.title: Chromatin tracing: the X chromosome in naive and primed human stem cells
datasets.name: Human pluripotent stem cells · chrX
datasets.tissue: female ES and iPS cells (H9, HES-3, H7, IMR-90 iPSC), naive and primed
datasets.description: 10,835 X chromosomes traced at 40 loci in female H9, HES-3 and H7 ES cells and IMR-90 iPS cells, primed (mTeSR1) and in naive conditions (5iLA, 5iLAF, 4iLAF+tMEKi), some with XIST or ATRX RNA FISH marking each copy (XIST+ / XIST-, ATRX+ / ATRX-) and a time course of H7 cells; the set and its description per chromosome. 21 4DN sets.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)

datasets.title: Chromatin tracing: maternal and paternal chromosome V in C. elegans embryos
datasets.name: C. elegans embryos · chrV, by parent

datasets.title: Hi-M: the dpp locus in Drosophila embryos
datasets.name: Drosophila embryos · dpp locus
datasets.description: 19,211 traces of 35 loci across 430 kb around dpp (chr2L) in intact embryos at nuclear cycles 12 and 14. Two 4DN sets.

datasets.title: Dip-C and 3-D structures: human GM12878 cells
datasets.name: GM12878 lymphoblastoid cells · 14 cells
datasets.description: 14 cells with their contacts (hickit re-processing on GEO) binned at 5 kb per cell (and 1 Mb), and the authors' diploid Dip-C structures (20 kb particles, one trace per chromosome copy): the main run as the coordinates, two replicate runs as layers, with their deviation from the main run per particle and per cell; a Hi-C embedding of the cells (scHiCluster, 1 Mb).

datasets.title: Single-cell Hi-C and 3-D structures: rice gametes and zygotes
datasets.name: Rice egg, sperm, zygote, shoot cells · 15 cells
datasets.tissue: egg cells, sperm cells, unicellular zygotes, shoot cells
datasets.description: 15 cells (4 egg, 4 sperm, 3 zygote, 4 shoot) with their contacts (2,200-17,300 per cell) binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, and the authors' NucDynamics structure of each cell (5 kb particles, one trace per chromosome); cell types from GEO.

datasets.title: Single-nucleus Hi-C and 3-D structures: haploid mouse ES cells exiting pluripotency
datasets.name: Haploid mouse ES cells, naive to primed · 36 cells

figure.caption: Haploid mouse ES cell, NucDynamics model 1

datasets.tissue: ES cells (haploid, 129/Ola): naive, 24 h Rex1-high and Rex1-low, 48 h primed
datasets.description: 36 cells (3 naive, 8 Rex1-high and 15 Rex1-low after 24 h, 9 primed after 48 h) with their contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, and the authors' NucDynamics structures (100 kb particles; model 1 as the coordinates, model 2 as a layer, their deviation per particle and per cell); a Hi-C embedding with Leiden clusters.

datasets.title: Dip-C and 3-D structures: mouse retina and olfactory epithelium
datasets.name: Mouse retina, olfactory epithelium · 409 cells
datasets.tissue: retina (132 cells), main olfactory epithelium (277 cells)
datasets.description: 409 cells with their contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, and the authors' diploid Dip-C structures (20 kb particles averaged to 100 kb, one trace per chromosome copy): run 1 as the coordinates, run 2 as a layer with their deviation per particle and per cell (the runs agree within 5 particle radii for 297 cells; the others are mostly shallow cells); a Hi-C embedding with Leiden clusters.
datasets.paper: Tan et al. 2019, Nature Structural & Molecular Biology

datasets.title: Single-cell Hi-C and 3-D structures: human sperm
datasets.name: Human sperm · 1,028 cells
datasets.description: 1,028 sperm cells with their contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, and the authors' haploid structures (20 kb particles averaged to 100 kb, one trace per chromosome); a Hi-C embedding with Leiden clusters.

datasets.title: Single-cell Hi-C and 3-D structures: mouse sperm and ES cells
datasets.name: Mouse sperm, ES cells · 787 cells
datasets.tissue: sperm (739 cells), ES cells as controls (48 cells)
datasets.description: 739 sperm cells and 48 ES cells with their contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, and the authors' structures (20 kb particles averaged to 100 kb, one trace per chromosome copy); a Hi-C embedding with Leiden clusters (the ES cells form a cluster of their own).

datasets.title: LiMCA: 3-D genome and RNA of mouse olfactory epithelium cells
datasets.name: Mouse olfactory epithelium · 410 cells

figure.caption: Mature olfactory sensory neuron, Dip-C structure

datasets.tissue: main olfactory epithelium, postnatal day 3 to 119
datasets.description: 410 cells (mature and immature olfactory sensory neurons, two progenitor types; the authors' cell types) from mice aged 3 to 119 days: contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, the authors' diploid structures (20 kb particles averaged to 100 kb, one trace per chromosome copy; run 1 as the coordinates, run 2 as a layer with their deviation per particle and per cell), and the RNA counts of the same cells; RNA and Hi-C embeddings, Leiden clusters of the RNA.

datasets.title: HiRES: female mouse ES cells during X inactivation
datasets.name: Female mouse ES cells, day 0-4 · 1,741 cells

figure.caption: ES cell on day 4, diploid structure

datasets.tissue: ES cells (C57BL/6J x CAST/EiJ, female), differentiating
datasets.description: 1,741 cells harvested from day 0 to day 4 of differentiation (eight time points, half days included): contacts binned at 100 kb per cell and all cells merged, the authors' diploid structures (20 kb particles averaged to 200 kb, one trace per chromosome copy), the authors' metadata (day, sample, structure RMSDs, Y/X ratio) and RNA counts of 1,507 cells (the deposited count tables lack the others); RNA and Hi-C embeddings, Leiden clusters of the RNA.
datasets.paper: Liu et al. 2026, Genomics, Proteomics & Bioinformatics

datasets.title: DNA seqFISH+: NMuMG mouse mammary epithelial cells

datasets.name: Mouse ES cells (E14), replicate 1 · 523 cells
datasets.description: 523 cells of 11 fields of view; chromosome copies traced in 3-D genome-wide (100,049 targeted loci, about 49,000 detected per cell) with 62 immunofluorescence and RNA signals per locus.
